units.quote: De otro lado, en zonas semiáridas de China, las terrazas de banco ancho resultaban más efectivas que las pendientes vegetadas en cuanto a la retención de la humedad (hasta un 22% más) (22), lo que es relevante para el caso de los andenes en el Perú, debido a la estructura y contexto climático similares. (English: On the other hand, in semi-arid zones of China, broad bench terraces were more effective than vegetated slopes at retaining moisture (up to 22% more), which is relevant to the case of andenes in Peru given the similar structure and climatic context. units.quote: Bergaoui et Albergel en Tunisie semi-aride (2000) ont étudié sur un bassin montagneux de 780 ha l’effet d’un aménagement complexe comportant la mise en défens des parcours, des cordons de pierres isohypses formant terrasses progressives (60% de la surface) et l’empierrement des ravines. En comparant 71 crues à une pointe, avant et après l’aménagement, ils ont montré le rallongement du temps de montée, l’étalement des crues (temps de base doublé), l’écrêtement des débits de pointe (=1/3), donc des transports solides et la réduction de 50% du volume ruisselé. (English: Bergaoui and Albergel in semi-arid Tunisia (2000) studied, on a 780 ha mountain catchment, the effect of a complex treatment comprising rangeland closure, contour stone bunds forming progressive terraces (60% of the area) and stone-filling of gullies. Comparing 71 single-peak floods before and after treatment, they showed lengthening of the rise time, spreading of floods (base time doubled), clipping of peak discharges (=1/3), hence of sediment transport, and a 50% reduction of runoff volume.)

relationship.outcome_raw: runoff volume of 71 single-peak floods before vs after treatment (780 ha catchment): -50 percent; peak discharge clipped (=1/3), base time doubled

context.note: Bundle includes rangeland closure + gully stone-filling, not bunds alone. | process: strength pass 2026-10-06: supersedes ev_flood_hazard_roose06_2; magnitude = the stated 50 percent reduction of flood runoff volume across the 71 compared floods; the peak-discharge clipping '(=1/3)' is strong under either reading (by or to one third) but is not encodable verbatim
